sys_security_acl.description:
Deactivated due to redundancy with the following acls: https://hoccdcdv.service-now.com/nav_to.do?uri=sys_security_acl.do?sys_id=275422f91b2141109fde86acdd4bcb07 and https://hoccdcdv.service-now.com/nav_to.do?uri=sys_security_acl.do?sys_id=235e8ed71be3f914813f844fdd4bcb64. Created when the general user acl was superceding the committee dynamic filter. User role was restricted to not apply for committee members fixing the issue and making this acl redundant.
Allow read for records in x_hccc_hoc_ohs_investigation_case, for users with roles (x_hccc_hoc_ohs.committee, x_hccc_hoc_ohs.advisor, x_hccc_hoc_ohs.admin), and if the ACL script returns true, and if the ACL condition (hr_service=31ecd2f31b081d109fde86acdd4bcb9b^pdf_template=2306fd9c8774ad5050d2eca73cbb3500^ORpdf_template=55703d708701a99450d2eca73cbb3566^EQ) evaluates to true.
